bio.text: Nellie Pou was sworn into the U.S. House of Representatives on January 3, 2025, representing New Jersey's 9th District; her office describes her as the first Latina from New Jersey to serve in Congress.
She previously served in the New Jersey Senate for the 35th Legislative District, first elected in 2011, and before that in the General Assembly beginning in 1997.
Her office says she worked for more than 40 years for the City of Paterson, including as Director of Human Resources and Business Administrator.
